::: {#about-content}

I'm a product-focused data scientist with 6+ years building and shipping ML systems across CPG, retail, and real estate. I like problems where the modeling choice changes a business decision — and I care about work that survives contact with production.

I'm currently a Senior Data Scientist (Team Lead) at Globant, leading the data science and engineering effort on a payroll fraud detection platform for a Big 4 client. I architected the end-to-end, cloud-agnostic ML and data pipelines that made the system SaaS-ready, cutting development time for new clients by 40%, and built a configurable, multi-algorithm anomaly detection platform that plugs into client front-end/back-end stacks with minimal manual intervention. The stack spans Azure ML, Synapse, Prefect, Docker, Azure Functions, and AWS SageMaker, chosen specifically so the pipelines stay portable across cloud vendors.

Before that, I spent three years at Tiger Analytics as a Data Scientist (Project Lead), where most of the numbers on this site's project pages come from. I designed and productionized a PySpark-based demand forecasting accelerator on Databricks (0.94 parallelization factor, used across 20+ projects) that took model development from weeks to days. On out-of-stock prevention for a major US retailer, I led a solution that trained 300,000 models over a 2TB dataset with automated backtesting and hyperparameter tuning, avoiding $2.4M in stockout and expiry losses. A parallel engagement in Russia trained 50,000 models to 84% accuracy on high-quality segments, and a Temporal Fusion Transformer for cross-learning added a further 17% uplift over the previous best models. I also co-built a time-series anomaly detection accelerator with automated root-cause analysis, a trade-promotion optimization tool for a UK client, and prototyped an LLM + RAG marketing assistant that took 2nd place in Tiger Analytics' internal hackathon.

Earlier roles: Data Scientist & Developer at vCreaTek (real-estate decision support systems, API gateway productionization), a Software Engineer Apprenticeship at Persistent Systems (led an 8-person team building a COVID-19 pedestrian-detection pipeline in one month), and an AI internship at IoTIoT.in (face-recognition pipeline, MTCNN + FaceNet). I hold a B.E. in Computer Science from Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology (SPPU, Pune), First Class with Distinction.

Tools I reach for: Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, Spark, Dask, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, FastAPI, Streamlit, RAG/vector stores, and OpenAI/Hugging Face for LLM work.

The fastest way to see how I think is the [projects](projects/index.qmd) page — those go deep on the Tiger Analytics work above. Code lives on [GitHub](https://github.com/Ashish-Surve); reach me at [surve.ashish@outlook.com](mailto:surve.ashish@outlook.com).

:::
